resources.name: AllocationJournal
resources.doc:
Unique ordinal seals one pool state transition. Raw rows are NOT authority
until the bounded consuming interpreter validates the complete chain.

resources.name: AllocationReservation
resources.doc: Inert candidate: only a valid committed pool journal authorizes ownership.

resources.name: ClassificationAssignment
resources.doc: An assignment records exact historical meaning; no floating latest concept.

resources.name: Concept
resources.doc: Ordinal is a stable taxonomy-local successor ordering, not display order.

resources.name: ConceptDisposition
resources.doc: One terminal fact retires a concept or points to an exact successor meaning.

resources.name: Taxonomy
resources.doc: Business vocabulary, independent of governance dataClass semantics.

resources.name: FulfillmentEnd
resources.doc: Terminal business observation wins over any late execution-start report.

resources.name: FulfillmentExecutor
resources.doc: Executor-specific handle; domain satellites own human/agent/equipment details.

resources.name: FulfillmentTaskLink
resources.doc: Kernel task address, not an application EntityRef or business request payload.

resources.name: UsageCorrection
resources.doc: A staged replacement contributes only after this terminal link is committed.

resources.name: UsageDimension
resources.doc: Domain vocabulary fixes one exact unit per dimension; conversion is explicit above.

classification.business: declared domain errors: served, counted separately
classification.counting: one event per logical operation; retries are attempts on the same event, never new events
